title: AI-Powered Crop Disease Detection
description: Build a mobile app that uses computer vision to detect diseases in crop leaves from photos.
problem_statement: Farmers need a quick way to identify crop diseases without expert consultation. Create a solution that allows farmers to take a photo of a leaf and get an instant diagnosis with treatment recommendations.
objectives: Train a CNN model on a dataset of diseased leaf images.
Develop a mobile app with camera integration.
Provide disease name, severity, and suggested remedies.

title: Blockchain-Based Supply Chain Traceability
description: Create a decentralized system to track goods from origin to consumer, ensuring authenticity.
problem_statement: Counterfeit products cost businesses billions. Build a blockchain solution that records every step of a product's journey, allowing consumers to verify authenticity via QR code.
objectives: Design a smart contract for product lifecycle events.
Build a web dashboard for producers and consumers.
Implement QR code generation and scanning.

title: Personalized Learning Path Generator
description: An AI system that recommends customized learning resources based on a user's skill gaps.
problem_statement: Students often waste time on content they already know. Build a platform that assesses a student's current knowledge and generates a step-by-step learning plan with curated resources.
objectives: Implement a knowledge graph of topics and prerequisites.
Create a quiz system to evaluate user proficiency.
Recommend videos, articles, and exercises based on gaps.

title: Smart Irrigation System Using IoT
description: Develop an IoT-based system that optimizes water usage in agriculture based on soil moisture and weather.
problem_statement: Water scarcity is a major issue. Build a system that collects soil moisture and weather data to control irrigation pumps automatically, reducing water waste.
objectives: Read soil moisture sensors and weather APIs.
Implement logic to decide watering schedules.
Provide a dashboard for monitoring and manual override.

title: Waste Sorting Robot with Computer Vision
description: Build a robot that automatically sorts recyclable materials from waste using image recognition.
problem_statement: Recycling plants rely on manual sorting, which is inefficient. Create a robot that uses a camera to identify types of waste (plastic, metal, paper) and places them into correct bins.
objectives: Train a classification model on waste images.
Build a robotic arm or conveyor belt system.
Achieve >90% accuracy in sorting.

title: Decentralized Identity Management
description: Create a self-sovereign identity system that allows users to control their personal data.
problem_statement: Centralized identity providers are prone to breaches. Build a system where users own their identity and can selectively share credentials with third parties without a central authority.
objectives: Implement DID (Decentralized Identifier) generation.
Create a wallet app for storing credentials.
Design a verifiable credential exchange protocol.

title: Smart Parking Management System
description: Develop a system that helps drivers find available parking spots in real-time using sensors and data aggregation.
problem_statement: City drivers waste time searching for parking, causing congestion. Build a system that collects occupancy data from parking lots and guides drivers to free spots via a mobile app.
objectives: Simulate or integrate real sensors.
Provide a real-time map of parking availability.
Allow users to reserve spots in advance.

title: Voice-Controlled Home Automation
description: Create a voice assistant that controls smart home devices like lights, fans, and doors.
problem_statement: People with mobility issues can benefit from voice-activated home controls. Build a system that recognizes natural language commands and executes them on smart devices.
objectives: Implement offline speech-to-text (or use cloud API).
Control devices via MQTT or home automation protocols.
Provide feedback via voice or text.

title: E-commerce Recommendation Engine
description: Build a recommendation system that suggests products to users based on their browsing and purchase history.
problem_statement: Online stores need to increase conversion by showing relevant products. Create a collaborative filtering and content-based hybrid recommendation engine.
objectives: Implement user-user and item-item collaborative filtering.
Add content-based recommendations using product metadata.
Create an API that serves recommendations in real-time.

title: Real-Time Public Transit Tracker
description: Develop a system that tracks buses/trains in real-time and predicts arrival times using GPS data.
problem_statement: Commuters need accurate arrival times to plan their journeys. Build a system that aggregates GPS feeds from transit vehicles and predicts arrival times using historical and real-time data.
objectives: Ingest and process GPS data streams.
Provide a map-based UI showing vehicle positions.
Implement predictive algorithms for arrival times.

title: Disaster Response Coordination Platform
description: Build a platform that connects volunteers, NGOs, and government agencies during natural disasters.
problem_statement: During disasters, coordination is chaotic. Create a centralized platform to track resources, volunteer availability, and affected areas, enabling efficient response.
objectives: Allow agencies to post resource needs and offers.
Map affected areas with geo-tagging.
Provide real-time updates and alerts.

title: Telemedicine Consultation System
description: Create a platform that connects patients with doctors for remote consultations via video and chat.
problem_statement: Access to healthcare is limited in rural areas. Build a system that allows patients to book appointments, consult doctors via video call, and receive prescriptions.
objectives: Implement patient and doctor registration.
Enable video call functionality.
Provide secure messaging and file sharing.

title: Renewable Energy Grid Optimizer
description: Build a system that optimizes the distribution of renewable energy (solar, wind) across a grid to minimize costs and waste.
problem_statement: Renewable sources are intermittent. Create an AI-based optimizer that predicts energy production and consumption to balance the grid and reduce reliance on fossil fuels.
objectives: Forecast solar/wind energy production using weather data.
Develop an optimization algorithm for load balancing.
Visualize grid status and recommendations.

title: Sentiment Analysis for Social Impact
description: Develop a tool that analyzes social media sentiment to measure public opinion on social issues and policy changes.
problem_statement: Organizations need to gauge public reaction to initiatives. Build a sentiment analysis system that processes tweets, news articles, and comments to track sentiment trends over time.
objectives: Collect data from social media APIs.
Implement sentiment classification (positive/negative/neutral).
Provide a dashboard with time-series charts.

title: Autonomous Drone for Crop Monitoring
description: Create a drone system that autonomously flies over agricultural fields to monitor crop health and detect pests.
problem_statement: Manual field inspection is time-consuming. Build a drone that can fly pre-programmed paths, capture multispectral images, and identify areas of stress or pest infestation.
objectives: Program autonomous flight missions.
Process images to detect anomalies.
Deliver a map of problem zones.

title: Smart Traffic Light Control
description: Build an adaptive traffic light system that adjusts timings based on real-time traffic flow.
problem_statement: Fixed traffic light timings cause unnecessary delays. Create a system that uses cameras to count vehicles at intersections and dynamically adjusts green light durations.
objectives: Implement vehicle detection using computer vision.
Develop a control algorithm to minimize wait times.
Provide a simulation or real hardware demo.

title: Peer-to-Peer Energy Trading Platform
description: Create a platform that allows households with solar panels to trade excess energy with neighbors.
problem_statement: Prosumers waste surplus energy. Build a blockchain-based marketplace where users can sell excess solar energy to neighbors at dynamic prices.
objectives: Implement smart contracts for energy tokenization.
Build a web UI for trading.
Integrate with smart meters (simulated).

title: Gamified Cybersecurity Training
description: Develop an interactive game that teaches cybersecurity concepts through challenges and simulations.
problem_statement: Cybersecurity awareness is low. Create a gamified platform where users solve security challenges (phishing detection, password cracking, etc.) to learn best practices.
objectives: Design a series of cybersecurity puzzles.
Implement scoring and leaderboards.
Provide feedback and explanations.

title: COVID-19 Contact Tracing App
description: Build a privacy-preserving contact tracing app using Bluetooth to alert users of potential exposure.
problem_statement: During pandemics, manual contact tracing is slow. Create an app that uses Bluetooth to log encounters and notifies users if they have been near a confirmed case.
objectives: Implement Bluetooth proximity logging.
Ensure user privacy with decentralized storage.
Integrate with health authority APIs for positive cases.

title: Automated Resume Screener
description: Build a tool that uses NLP to screen resumes and rank candidates for job positions.
problem_statement: HR teams receive hundreds of resumes. Create a system that extracts key skills, experience, and education, and matches them to job descriptions to rank candidates.
objectives: Parse and extract information from resumes (PDF/DOCX).
Compute similarity score with job description.
Provide a ranked list with highlights.

title: Realtime Sign Language Translator
description: Develop a tool that translates sign language gestures into text or speech using computer vision.
problem_statement: Deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals face communication barriers. Build a system that recognizes sign language gestures from a webcam and converts them to text/speech in real-time.
objectives: Collect and label a sign language dataset.
Train a model to recognize gestures.
Build a real-time translation app.

title: Last-Mile Delivery Optimization
description: Build a route optimization system for delivery fleets to minimize fuel and time.
problem_statement: Delivery companies struggle with last-mile costs. Create a system that takes orders and vehicle constraints to generate optimal routes considering traffic and time windows.
objectives: Implement VRP (Vehicle Routing Problem) solver.
Provide a map visualization of routes.
Allow dispatchers to adjust and reassign.

title: Mental Health Chatbot
description: Build a conversational AI that provides emotional support and coping strategies for mental health.
problem_statement: Many people lack access to mental health resources. Create a chatbot that engages in supportive conversations, checks mood, and suggests activities or professional help when needed.
objectives: Design conversation flows for common mental health scenarios.
Implement sentiment analysis to detect distress.
Provide resources and crisis hotline information.

title: Smart Meter Data Analytics for Utilities
description: Develop a platform that analyzes smart meter data to detect anomalies and provide energy-saving tips.
problem_statement: Utilities collect massive smart meter data but don't leverage it effectively. Build a system that identifies unusual consumption patterns (leaks, faulty appliances) and recommends efficiency measures.
objectives: Ingest and process time-series data.
Implement anomaly detection algorithms.
Deliver a dashboard with actionable insights.

title: Crowdfunding Platform for Social Projects
description: Create a crowdfunding platform focused on social impact projects with transparent tracking of fund usage.
problem_statement: Donors want to know how their money is used. Build a platform where project creators can post milestones, and donors see exactly where funds go, with blockchain-backed transparency.
objectives: Implement project creation and donation.
Track funds and project progress.
Provide transparency reports.

title: Autonomous Navigation for Wheelchair
description: Develop a system to help wheelchair users navigate safely indoors using computer vision and sensors.
problem_statement: Wheelchair users face obstacles in indoor environments. Build a system that detects obstacles and plans a safe path, possibly converting a standard wheelchair into an autonomous one.
objectives: Implement obstacle detection and SLAM.
Develop path planning algorithm.
Integrate with wheelchair controls.

title: AR-based Learning for Science Experiments
description: Build an augmented reality app that overlays interactive 3D models to teach science concepts.
problem_statement: Students struggle with abstract concepts in physics and chemistry. Create an AR app that visualizes molecules, circuits, or planetary motions in 3D, allowing manipulation and experimentation.
objectives: Design 3D models for educational content.
Implement AR tracking and interaction.
Build lesson modules with quizzes.

title: Fraud Detection in Insurance Claims
description: Develop a machine learning model to detect fraudulent insurance claims.
problem_statement: Insurance fraud costs billions. Build a system that uses historical claims data to flag suspicious patterns and assign a fraud risk score.
objectives: Preprocess and feature-engineer claims data.
Train and evaluate multiple models.
Create an API that accepts claims and returns risk score.

title: Ocean Plastic Cleanup Drone
description: Build a drone concept that can detect and collect plastic waste from ocean surfaces.
problem_statement: Ocean plastic pollution is a crisis. Design an autonomous surface drone that uses cameras to detect floating plastic and a collection mechanism to gather it.
objectives: Implement plastic detection using semantic segmentation.
Design collection mechanism (simulated).
Simulate or build a small-scale prototype.

title: Dynamic Pricing for Ride-Sharing
description: Create a pricing engine that adjusts fares in real-time based on demand, supply, and external factors.
problem_statement: Ride-sharing companies need to balance supply and demand. Build a system that predicts demand surges and sets optimal prices to maximize utilization and revenue.
objectives: Analyze historical trip data.
Implement a demand forecasting model.
Create a pricing API that responds to real-time events.

title: Smart Bin for Waste Segregation
description: Build a smart waste bin that automatically separates recyclables using sensors and mechanical sorting.
problem_statement: Many people don't sort waste correctly. Create a bin that uses a camera to identify types of waste and diverts them into separate compartments.
objectives: Train a lightweight image classifier for waste types.
Build a mechanical sorting mechanism.
Demonstrate with a prototype.

title: Virtual Classroom with Engagement Analytics
description: Develop a virtual classroom platform that tracks student engagement and provides feedback to teachers.
problem_statement: Online classes often lack engagement. Build a platform with video conferencing, screen sharing, and tools to monitor attention (via facial expressions, participation) and give teachers real-time insights.
objectives: Implement video chat with screen sharing.
Collect engagement metrics (poll responses, video activity).
Provide a dashboard for teachers.

title: Cybersecurity Threat Intelligence Feed
description: Create a system that aggregates and analyzes threat intelligence from multiple sources and provides actionable alerts.
problem_statement: Organizations need to stay ahead of emerging threats. Build a platform that ingests threat data (CVE, blogs, dark web), correlates it with internal assets, and prioritizes alerts.
objectives: Collect data from APIs and scrapers.
Implement correlation and scoring algorithms.
Provide a visualization dashboard.

title: Crop Yield Prediction from Satellite Imagery
description: Develop a model that predicts crop yields using satellite images and weather data.
problem_statement: Farmers and governments need yield forecasts for planning. Build a system that processes satellite imagery (NDVI) and weather data to predict yields at field level.
objectives: Access and preprocess satellite and weather data.
Train a regression model.
Create a web interface for predictions.

title: Digital Wallet for Micro-Transactions
description: Create a lightweight digital wallet for small transactions (e.g., street vendors, micro-payments) with low fees.
problem_statement: Cash is still dominant in many small transactions. Build a mobile wallet that allows users to transfer small amounts instantly with minimal fees, using QR codes for peer-to-peer payments.
objectives: Implement user accounts and balance management.
Generate and scan QR codes for payments.
Ensure transaction security.

title: Emergency Evacuation Routing for Fires
description: Develop a system that calculates safe evacuation routes in real-time during building fires using sensor data.
problem_statement: In a fire, people need fast and safe exits. Build a system that uses smoke and heat sensors to map danger zones and dynamically route occupants to the safest exits.
objectives: Simulate a building with sensors.
Implement real-time pathfinding algorithm.
Provide a visual interface with floor plan.

title: AI-based Medical Diagnosis Support
description: Build a system that assists doctors by analyzing symptoms and suggesting possible diagnoses.
problem_statement: Diagnostic errors are common. Create a decision support system that takes patient symptoms and history, and outputs a ranked list of likely conditions with confidence scores.
objectives: Curate a medical dataset of symptoms and diseases.
Train a multi-label classification model.
Provide an interface for doctors to input cases.

title: Green Building Energy Efficiency Audit
description: Develop a tool that analyzes building energy consumption and suggests retrofits for efficiency.
problem_statement: Buildings account for significant emissions. Create a system that ingests utility bills, weather data, and building characteristics to identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements.
objectives: Calculate energy benchmarks (EUI).
Detect anomalies and potential savings.
Generate a report with actionable recommendations.

title: Real-time Collaborative Code Editor
description: Build a web-based code editor where multiple users can collaborate simultaneously with syntax highlighting and terminal access.
problem_statement: Remote pair programming is challenging. Create a collaborative editor that supports multiple cursors, language-specific autocompletion, and a shared terminal for executing code.
objectives: Implement operational transformation (OT) or CRDT for syncing.
Integrate a code execution sandbox.
Add voice/video chat (optional).

title: Automated Trading Bot for Cryptocurrencies
description: Develop a bot that executes trades on crypto exchanges based on technical indicators and sentiment analysis.
problem_statement: Crypto markets are volatile. Build a bot that monitors prices, news sentiment, and trading volume to execute buy/sell orders automatically using a strategy.
objectives: Connect to exchange APIs for real-time data.
Implement a trading strategy (e.g., moving average crossover).
Backtest and optimize the strategy.

title: Smart Helmet for Miners
description: Create a helmet with sensors to monitor environmental conditions and alert miners to hazards.
problem_statement: Mining is dangerous. Build a helmet that measures gas levels, temperature, and detects falls, sending alerts to a central control room.
objectives: Integrate gas sensors and accelerometer.
Provide real-time data transmission.
Create a dashboard for monitoring.

title: Personalized News Aggregator
description: Build a news aggregator that curates articles based on user interests and reading history.
problem_statement: People are overwhelmed with information. Create a system that scrapes news from multiple sources, categorizes topics, and recommends articles tailored to each user's preferences.
objectives: Implement article scraping and categorization.
Build a recommendation engine using collaborative filtering.
Provide a clean reading interface.

title: AI Essay Grader for Teachers
description: Develop a tool that automatically grades student essays and provides feedback on grammar, coherence, and argumentation.
problem_statement: Grading essays is time-consuming. Build a system that uses NLP to evaluate essays on multiple dimensions (content, structure, language) and offers constructive feedback.
objectives: Fine-tune a language model on graded essays.
Generate scores and comments.
Provide a web interface for teachers.

title: Peer-to-Peer Car Rental Platform
description: Create a platform where car owners can rent out their vehicles to others, with insurance and verification.
problem_statement: Many cars sit idle. Build a platform that connects car owners with renters, handling booking, payment, and insurance verification.
objectives: Implement listing and search for cars.
Handle booking and payment processing.
Integrate identity verification.

title: Flood Prediction and Alert System
description: Develop a system that uses weather data and river levels to predict flood risks and send alerts to vulnerable communities.
problem_statement: Floods cause huge damage. Build a predictive model using rainfall and water level data, and alert residents via SMS and app notifications when levels exceed thresholds.
objectives: Collect historical and real-time weather/water data.
Train a regression model for water level forecasting.
Set up alerting with geolocation targeting.

title: Social Media Hate Speech Detector
description: Build a tool that automatically detects and flags hate speech in social media posts.
problem_statement: Hate speech spreads online. Create a system that scans posts and comments, labels them as hate speech or not, and provides a moderation dashboard.
objectives: Fine-tune a BERT-based model for hate speech detection.
Implement a real-time API.
Build a moderation interface with action options.

title: Smart Inventory Management with RFID
description: Develop a system that tracks inventory using RFID tags and provides real-time stock levels and reorder alerts.
problem_statement: Retailers lose sales due to stockouts. Build a system that automatically updates inventory when items are moved, and triggers reorder when thresholds are reached.
objectives: Integrate with RFID readers (simulate).
Provide dashboard with stock alerts.
Generate purchase order suggestions.

title: Gesture-Controlled Drone
description: Build a drone that can be controlled by hand gestures using computer vision.
problem_statement: Remote controls are limiting. Create a system that uses a webcam to recognize gestures (wave, swipe, etc.) and translates them into drone commands (takeoff, move, land).
objectives: Implement hand gesture recognition in real-time.
Map gestures to drone commands.
Test with a drone simulator or actual drone.

title: Carbon Footprint Tracker for Commuters
description: Develop a mobile app that tracks a user's travel modes and calculates their carbon footprint, suggesting greener alternatives.
problem_statement: People want to reduce their carbon emissions but lack awareness. Build an app that automatically detects travel mode (car, bus, bike) using GPS and gives CO2 estimates, with alternative route suggestions.
objectives: Classify travel mode from motion data.
Calculate emissions using standard factors.
Provide gamification and tips.

title: Scam Detection for Online Transactions
description: Create a browser extension that warns users when they are on a potentially fraudulent website.
problem_statement: Phishing scams are common. Build a tool that analyzes website URL, content, and SSL certificate to assign a risk score and alert users in real-time.
objectives: Collect features from website metadata.
Train a classification model on known phishing sites.
Build a browser extension that displays warnings.
